scope: Read-only source/transport review. No SQL mutations, no production access, no implementation edits.
verdict: No unconditional blocker found for complete generated SQL executed by a fail-fast client. Conditional staging completeness gap requires explicit fail-fast execution or SQL guard.

conditional_finding.severity: P2 if SOURCE or continue-on-error clients are supported; otherwise residual hardening risk
conditional_finding.issue: No expected cardinality or equality-of-ID-set assertion for hash and value staging tables. A failed hash INSERT followed by continued execution leaves value rows that joined UPDATE changes outside preflight and afterimage verification.
conditional_finding.suggested_fix: Before opening cursor, require each temporary table to have len(pairs) rows and require no IDs missing in either direction; state client must abort on SQL errors.
conditional_finding.suggested_regression: Generate multiple hash batches, omit a late hash batch while preserving all value batches, then call procedure: require exception and all persistent items unchanged. Also test missing value batches and late afterimage failure.
